en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning cancelled after nine consecutive hot days
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory lifted the warning at 7.20pm on Thursday as temperatures eased; the city had recorded highs of 33 degrees Celsius or above for nine days running.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Very Hot Weather Warning at 7.20pm on Thursday after it had remained in force throughout the day.

The city had recorded maximum temperatures of 33 degrees Celsius or above for nine consecutive days, matching the longest such stretch for August. Earlier, the Observatory noted that extreme heat would ease only slightly, with urban highs around 34 degrees and some New Territories areas still hotter.

A southwest airstream brought some cloud and isolated showers. The Observatory expected more showers and thunderstorms in places on Friday, followed by sunny intervals and a few showers over the weekend. The Labour Department also cancelled the Heat Stress at Work Warning in the evening.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告晚上取消 連續九日最高溫33度或以上
zh.dek: 天文台周四晚上7時20分取消酷熱天氣警告；本港連續九日錄得最高氣溫33度或以上，平八月最長紀錄。
body: 香港天文台周四晚上7時20分取消酷熱天氣警告，警告全日生效至傍晚。
天文台表示，本港近日持續高溫，截至今日已連續九日錄得最高氣溫33.0度或以上，平了八月份最長連續酷熱日數紀錄。日間市區最高氣溫約34度，新界部分地區再高。
一股西南氣流影響下，今日部分時間有陽光及幾陣驟雨。天文台預料星期五部分地區驟雨較多及有狂風雷暴，周末期間短暫時間有陽光，仍有幾陣驟雨。勞工處同日晚上亦取消工作暑熱警告。
